sources.title: Naturally inflating on steep potentials through electromagnetic dissipation

evidence.text: Can particle production from an axion–gauge coupling sustain inflation on a steep, radiatively stable axion potential with f≲MP, and can the resulting scalar perturbations have an acceptable amplitude?

sources.title: UV-Protected Inflation

evidence.text: Can a derivative coupling to the Einstein tensor enable single-axion Natural Inflation with a sub-Planckian decay constant, radiative stability, and perturbative control throughout the inflationary trajectory?

sources.title: Chromo-Natural Inflation: Natural inflation on a steep potential with classical non-Abelian gauge fields

evidence.text: Can classical non-Abelian gauge fields sustain slow-roll axion inflation on a steep potential with sub-Planckian decay constant, and can the resulting background plausibly produce acceptable primordial fluctuations?

sources.title: Gauge-flation Vs Chromo-Natural Inflation

evidence.text: How are Gauge-flation and axion-containing Chromo-Natural inflation connected, and can their apparently different slow-roll trajectories arise in distinct parameter regimes of the same axion–gauge theory?

sources.title: Kinetic Gravity Braiding and axion inflation

evidence.text: Can higher-derivative kinetic gravity braiding slow axion evolution enough to obtain sufficient inflation and a nearly scale-invariant scalar spectrum with a sub-Planckian decay constant, and which parameters can linear cosmological perturbations determine?

sources.title: Low-Energy Effective Field Theory for Chromo-Natural Inflation

evidence.text: When can the SU(2) fields in chromo-natural inflation be integrated out while retaining enhanced axion damping, and is the resulting scalar EFT stable, radiatively controlled, and useful for predicting inflationary perturbations?

sources.title: Spinodal Instabilities and Super-Planckian Excursions in Natural Inflation

evidence.text: Can non-equilibrium spinodal fluctuations make Natural Inflation viable with a sub-Planckian axion decay constant and without super-Planckian field excursions, while producing sufficient inflation and acceptable scalar and tensor spectra?

sources.title: Swampland, axions, and minimal warm inflation

evidence.text: Can a concrete axion-induced thermal bath sustain inflation on steep potentials while reproducing the observed scalar spectrum and respecting the paper's de Sitter, distance, and trans-Planckian criteria?

sources.title: Thermal, trapped and chromo-natural inflation in light of the swampland criteria and the trans-Planckian censorship conjecture

evidence.text: Can a gauge interaction provide enough damping for a sub-Planckian-decay-constant axion to inflate on its naturally steep cosine potential?

sources.title: Axion monodromy inflation, trapping mechanisms and the swampland

evidence.text: Can repeated production of additional fields slow the axion without false-vacuum trapping? Evenly spaced massless points and a positive linear potential allow particle-production slowing to be separated from periodic-potential trapping.

sources.title: No warm inflation from a vanilla axion

evidence.text: Can sphaleron heating sustain sufficiently long, strongly dissipative slow-roll inflation while preserving the defining periodicity and coupling structure of a vanilla axion? The argument seeks an obstruction independent of observational constraints.

sources.title: Heterotic warm inflation

evidence.text: How do axion–saxion kinetic coupling, gauge-mediated dissipation and thermal backreaction determine whether heterotic-motivated inflation is warm, effectively single-field or genuinely two-field?

sources.title: Naturally inflating on steep potentials through electromagnetic dissipation

evidence.text: Decompose the gauge field into helicities, solve its mode equation with Coulomb wave functions and positive-frequency initial conditions, then approximate the amplified helicity to estimate ⟨E·B⟩ and gauge-field energy.

sources.title: UV-Protected Inflation

evidence.text: Use the gauge δφ=0 on a nontrivial scalar background and an ADM decomposition, treating lapse and shift as constraint variables. Canonically normalize perturbations to estimate background-dependent strong-coupling scales.

sources.title: Chromo-Natural Inflation: Natural inflation on a steep potential with classical non-Abelian gauge fields

evidence.text: Interpret the overdamped gauge equation through an effective potential, derive the axion trajectory in e-fold time, and estimate scalar fluctuations using δN≈(∂N/∂X₀)δX while neglecting gauge-field fluctuations.

sources.title: Gauge-flation Vs Chromo-Natural Inflation

evidence.text: Introduce a gauge-dependent source Ξ in the effective axion potential and extremize it. At leading slow-roll order, sin(χ/f) = Ξ ≃ 3gλHψ³/μ⁴, obtained after dropping ψ̇ relative to Hψ.

sources.title: Kinetic Gravity Braiding and axion inflation

evidence.text: Derive the homogeneous Einstein and scalar equations, impose slow roll and braiding dominance, and express slow-roll parameters through the enhancement parameter τ. Inflationary endpoints are determined by ε=1, and the e-fold integral is evaluated analytically or numerically for the two models.

sources.title: Low-Energy Effective Field Theory for Chromo-Natural Inflation

evidence.text: Estimate heavy-field corrections through a Wilsonian path integral and schematic Coleman–Weinberg derivative expansion. Import established P(X,χ) power-spectrum and bispectrum formulae to calculate model observables.

sources.title: Swampland, axions, and minimal warm inflation

evidence.text: Can the fitted interval be completed into an axion model with consistent discrete periodicity, controlled thermal backreaction, a physical exit, and a viable subsequent cosmology?

sources.title: The inflated Chern-Simons number in spectator chromo-natural inflation

evidence.text: Can phenomenologically interesting spectator chromo-natural inflation generate its required large quantized axion–gauge coupling through clockwork, while retaining observational agreement and calculational control? What additional restrictions follow from perturbative unitarity and conjectural quantum-gravity conditions?

sources.title: Clockwork Axions in Cosmology: Is Chromonatural Inflation Chrononatural?

evidence.text: Can the large axion-gauge couplings required by cosmological models be generated from smaller UV input integers through alignment or clockwork, especially for chromonatural inflation with a sub-Planckian effective axion range?

sources.title: Reheating after axion inflation

evidence.text: Does efficient tachyonic gauge production or thermal dissipation complete reheating immediately after axion inflation, or do surviving condensates, thermally produced inflaton particles and confined glueballs delay its completion?

sources.title: Swampland bounds on dark sectors

evidence.text: Does non-Abelian-assisted inflation with a sub-Planckian axion decay constant remain subject to the same FL obstruction as a long-lived de Sitter solution, once the short unsupported background lifetime is considered?

sources.title: Enhancement of the Axion Decay Constant in Inflation and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can axion inflation satisfy the assumed microscopic bound f < M_Pl while having an effective decay constant above M_Pl, through coherent harmonic cancellation or through noncanonical DBI dynamics?

sources.title: A review of Axion Inflation in the era of Planck

evidence.text: How can axion shift symmetry protect inflation from ultraviolet corrections, which constructions realize sufficient inflation, and what signatures and constraints follow in the Planck-2013 observational setting?

sources.title: Aligned Natural Inflation: Monodromies of two Axions

evidence.text: Can alignment of two axions provide the large effective displacement needed for natural inflation while keeping individual decay constants below the Planck scale, and how does the misalignment parameter determine the predicted scalar and tensor spectra?

sources.title: Trajectories with suppressed tensor-to-scalar ratio in Aligned Natural Inflation

evidence.text: Which inflationary trajectories occur in the general two-axion aligned potential, and can their scalar tilt, tensor amplitude or gauge-field couplings distinguish Aligned Natural Inflation from single-field Natural Inflation?

sources.title: Subleading Effects and the Field Range in Axion Inflation

evidence.text: Can significant but subleading nonperturbative axion corrections enhance inflationary e-folds, reduce the required field range and decay constant, and produce distinctive observables instead of trapping the inflaton or merely perturbing smooth slow roll?

sources.title: Systematics of Aligned Axions

evidence.text: How can exact and approximate shift symmetries make multi-axion potentials tractable, allowing systematic characterization of critical points, vacuum energies and smooth field-space regions relevant to inflation?

sources.title: Probing the Weak Gravity Conjecture in the Cosmic Microwave Background

evidence.text: Can axion-potential modulations motivated by the weak gravity conjecture reconcile natural inflation with CMB observations and produce distinguishable tensor and spectral-distortion signatures?

sources.title: Harmonic hybrid inflation

evidence.text: Can two axions with a purely nonperturbative periodic potential realize observationally viable hybrid inflation with limited field displacement and sub-Planckian decay constants, while avoiding domain walls?

sources.title: Pseudo-Nambu-Goldstone inflation with twin waterfalls

evidence.text: Can hybrid natural inflation end through twin waterfall fields while avoiding a trans-Planckian axion decay constant and dangerous radiative corrections from the waterfall couplings?

sources.title: Analytic results in aligned axion inflation

evidence.text: Can metastable trajectories in minimal aligned two-axion inflation be characterized analytically, including their existence, instability endpoint and CMB phenomenology, and does their short field excursion remove the trans-Planckian kinetic-scale problem?

sources.title: Dynamical System Analysis of Single-Axion Monodromy Inflation with Periodically Modulated Potentials

evidence.text: How do periodic modulations of single-axion potentials change the existence, stability and bifurcations of inflationary fixed points, and which parameters and initial conditions permit finite inflation lasting approximately 50–60 e-foldings?

sources.title: Catastrophic Inflation in the Axiverse

evidence.text: Can string-theory axions with sub-Planckian field ranges support slow-roll inflation through tuned mergers of critical points, without alignment, assuming saxions can be stabilized at the required cycle volumes?

sources.title: N-flation

evidence.text: Can many axions, each with sub-Planckian displacement and an individually inadequate inflationary potential, collectively produce prolonged slow roll under radiative control? What ultraviolet corrections limit the apparent improvement with field number?

sources.title: A review of Axion Inflation in the era of Planck

evidence.text: For Abelian production, the review presents helicity mode equations, constant-ξ Coulomb-function solutions and an adiabatic-vacuum approximation. Backreaction is described through a mean-field inflaton equation and an approximate sourced perturbation equation.

sources.title: Aligned Natural Inflation: Monodromies of two Axions

evidence.text: They expand the field transformation and light-direction potential in the alignment parameter, then expand the slow-roll expressions near ξ = 0. The reported observables use ε = (MPl²/2)(V′/V)², η = MPl²V″/V, ns = 1 − 6ε + 2η, and r = 16ε.

sources.title: Trajectories with suppressed tensor-to-scalar ratio in Aligned Natural Inflation

evidence.text: Numerically evolves the exact two-field model and computes n_s and r along the trajectories using slow-roll relations. Appendix B also evolves the coupled canonical perturbation modes from a deep-subhorizon adiabatic vacuum to evaluate adiabatic and entropy spectra.

sources.title: Subleading Effects and the Field Range in Axion Inflation

evidence.text: Numerically solve the Friedmann and Klein–Gordon equations, or the equivalent Hamilton–Jacobi equations when φ is a single-valued time variable. Compare smooth and modulated potentials under matched initial conditions and integrate the expansion to obtain e-fold counts.

sources.title: Systematics of Aligned Axions

evidence.text: Find extrema by constrained optimization with P−N Lagrange multipliers. A quadratic expansion gives analytic approximate minimum locations and energies through a coupling-dependent nonorthogonal projector. Convex-polytope lattice sampling supplies statistical samples without enumerating every tile.

sources.title: Probing the Weak Gravity Conjecture in the Cosmic Microwave Background

evidence.text: Model comparison uses the Deviance Information Criterion, including Bayesian complexity as an effective-parameter penalty. The best-fit estimator is obtained with CosmoMC's BOBYQA likelihood maximizer.

sources.title: Natural inflation, strong dynamics, and the role of generalized anomalies

evidence.text: Does the cosine-only effective potential remain adequate for natural inflation during large axion excursions? Can generalized anomaly matching explain the involvement of heavy strongly coupled modes, and how does retaining those modes change inflation?

sources.title: Natural Chain Inflation

evidence.text: Can chain inflation be realized by an axion in supergravity, with a practical prescription for CMB observables and a viable inflation scale, while advancing toward an eventual string-theory embedding?

sources.title: Heterotic warm inflation

evidence.text: How do axion–saxion kinetic coupling, gauge-mediated dissipation and thermal backreaction determine whether heterotic-motivated inflation is warm, effectively single-field or genuinely two-field?

sources.title: Natural inflation with and without modulations in type IIB string theory

evidence.text: Can a complex-structure axion realize natural inflation with a trans-Planckian effective decay constant through one-loop gauge thresholds, while other moduli are stabilized? When do subleading threshold terms produce consequential modulations?

sources.title: Geometrical Destabilisation of Ultra-Light Axions in String Inflation

evidence.text: Do curved kinetic terms destabilize ultra-light axionic isocurvature modes in Fibre Inflation, and can nonperturbative axion masses remove the instability while preserving the usual leading inflationary dynamics?

sources.title: Inflation by Alignment

evidence.text: How are kinetic and lattice alignment related in two-field inflation, and can the same mechanisms extend from compact axions to noncompact pseudo-Goldstone potentials, enhancing tensors or generating slow-roll?

sources.title: Planckian Axions in String Theory

evidence.text: Can many axions have a super-Planckian fundamental-domain diameter despite small eigenvalues of their original kinetic metric, and under what conditions can this geometric range support inflation?

sources.title: Spinodal Instabilities and Super-Planckian Excursions in Natural Inflation

evidence.text: Can non-equilibrium spinodal fluctuations make Natural Inflation viable with a sub-Planckian axion decay constant and without super-Planckian field excursions, while producing sufficient inflation and acceptable scalar and tensor spectra?

sources.title: Warping the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can a single open-string axion in a warped compactification have a super-Planckian decay constant consistently with the Weak Gravity Conjecture, and can the resulting construction support large-field inflation with observable primordial tensors?

sources.title: Helical Inflation and Cosmic Strings

evidence.text: Can a two-axion helical trajectory produce a super-Planckian effective field range, and can departures from quadratic inflation or a subdominant cosmic-string B-mode component reveal the underlying axionic scenario?

sources.title: Small field axion inflation with sub-Planckian decay constant

evidence.text: Can a previously proposed type IIB axion potential produce sufficient small-field inflation with a sub-Planckian decay constant, and what low inflation and reheating scales follow?

sources.title: Aligned natural inflation with modulations

evidence.text: Does aligned natural inflation compatible with the multi-axion weak gravity conjecture generically acquire subleading potential modulations, and what oscillations and observational constraints follow?

sources.title: Chromo-Natural Inflation: Natural inflation on a steep potential with classical non-Abelian gauge fields

evidence.text: Can classical non-Abelian gauge fields sustain slow-roll axion inflation on a steep potential with sub-Planckian decay constant, and can the resulting background plausibly produce acceptable primordial fluctuations?

sources.title: Natural and Multi-Natural Inflation in Axion Landscape

evidence.text: Can accidental alignment among many axions with sub-Planckian decay constants produce a sufficiently flat, super-Planckian inflationary direction, and connect slow-roll inflation after tunneling to the numbers of axions and symmetry-breaking sources?

sources.title: Constraints on small-field axion inflation

evidence.text: How do decay constants determine observables, inflaton masses, reheating temperatures, and dark-matter production in tuned small-field axion potentials? Which decay constants survive BBN and QCD-axion isocurvature constraints?

sources.title: Chaotic inflation with kinetic alignment of axion fields

evidence.text: Can kinetic mixing among N sub-Planckian axions produce a collective displacement exceeding their Pythagorean range, and under what conditions can inflation follow that enlarged direction?

sources.title: Modulated Natural Inflation

evidence.text: Can string-motivated higher instanton harmonics preserve trans-Planckian aligned axion inflation, satisfy the mild weak gravity conjecture, and change the CMB predictions of natural inflation?

sources.title: Inflation from periodic extra dimensions

evidence.text: Can periodic extra dimensions generate the multiple sinusoidal terms needed for small-field multi-natural inflation with a sub-Planckian decay constant, within an illustrative string-inspired supersymmetry-breaking construction?

sources.title: Kinetic Gravity Braiding and axion inflation

evidence.text: Can higher-derivative kinetic gravity braiding slow axion evolution enough to obtain sufficient inflation and a nearly scale-invariant scalar spectrum with a sub-Planckian decay constant, and which parameters can linear cosmological perturbations determine?

sources.title: Enhancement of the Axion Decay Constant in Inflation and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can axion inflation satisfy the assumed microscopic bound f < M_Pl while having an effective decay constant above M_Pl, through coherent harmonic cancellation or through noncanonical DBI dynamics?

sources.title: Completing natural inflation

evidence.text: Can natural inflation obtain a sufficiently flat axion potential and an effectively super-Planckian axion scale while keeping the underlying axion scales sub-Planckian?

sources.title: Naturally inflating on steep potentials through electromagnetic dissipation

evidence.text: Can particle production from an axion–gauge coupling sustain inflation on a steep, radiatively stable axion potential with f≲MP, and can the resulting scalar perturbations have an acceptable amplitude?

sources.title: Swampland, axions, and minimal warm inflation

evidence.text: Can a concrete axion-induced thermal bath sustain inflation on steep potentials while reproducing the observed scalar spectrum and respecting the paper's de Sitter, distance, and trans-Planckian criteria?

destinations.title: How can axion shift symmetry protect inflation from ultraviolet corrections, which constructions realize sufficient inflation, and what signatures and constraints follow in the Planck-2013 observational setting?

Can alignment of two axions provide the large effective displacement needed for natural inflation while keeping individual decay constants below the Planck scale, and how does the misalignment parameter determine the predicted scalar and tensor spectra?

Which inflationary trajectories occur in the general two-axion aligned potential, and can their scalar tilt, tensor amplitude or gauge-field couplings distinguish Aligned Natural Inflation from single-field Natural Inflation?

Can significant but subleading nonperturbative axion corrections enhance inflationary e-folds, reduce the required field range and decay constant, and produce distinctive observables instead of trapping the inflaton or merely perturbing smooth slow roll?

How can exact and approximate shift symmetries make multi-axion potentials tractable, allowing systematic characterization of critical points, vacuum energies and smooth field-space regions relevant to inflation?
Can axion-potential modulations motivated by the weak gravity conjecture reconcile natural inflation with CMB observations and produce distinguishable tensor and spectral-distortion signatures?

Can two axions with a purely nonperturbative periodic potential realize observationally viable hybrid inflation with limited field displacement and sub-Planckian decay constants, while avoiding domain walls?
Can hybrid natural inflation end through twin waterfall fields while avoiding a trans-Planckian axion decay constant and dangerous radiative corrections from the waterfall couplings?

Can metastable trajectories in minimal aligned two-axion inflation be characterized analytically, including their existence, instability endpoint and CMB phenomenology, and does their short field excursion remove the trans-Planckian kinetic-scale problem?

How do periodic modulations of single-axion potentials change the existence, stability and bifurcations of inflationary fixed points, and which parameters and initial conditions permit finite inflation lasting approximately 50–60 e-foldings?

Can string-theory axions with sub-Planckian field ranges support slow-roll inflation through tuned mergers of critical points, without alignment, assuming saxions can be stabilized at the required cycle volumes?

Can many axions, each with sub-Planckian displacement and an individually inadequate inflationary potential, collectively produce prolonged slow roll under radiative control? What ultraviolet corrections limit the apparent improvement with field number?
